name: Josefa Manuela Abarca Fallas — a son José Vidal born October 1899, San Juan de Dios, Desamparados, Costa Rica
researcher_question: Josefa Manuela Abarca Fallas, born 12 June 1873 at Aserrí, San José, daughter of Rafael de Jesús Abarca Monge and Francisca de Jesús Fallas Alfaro, married Juan García Calderón by civil registration in January 1892. What children did Manuela and Juan have?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 6, hint-samples.csv row 209, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-27 as a TRUE MATCH on index/record evidence (image_basis false). José Vidal García Abarca, b. 22 Oct 1899 San Juan de Dios (civil birth ark:/61903/1:1:QL6V-B2FY; baptism 24 Oct 1899 ark:/61903/1:1:NQ2L-5MY; death 28 Feb 1901 ark:/61903/1:1:7XRW-KN6Z), legitimate son of Juan García and Manuela Abarca of San Juan de Dios. The parents' marriage (church 14 Jan 1891 Aserrí, ark:/61903/1:1:66DM-DGK8 and ark:/61903/1:1:66DM-DGK4; civil marriage 14 Jan 1892 / registered 15 Jan 1892 San José, ark:/61903/1:1:6KJJ-CFF4 and ark:/61903/1:1:6KJJ-CFF3) names the bride as Manuela Abarca Fallas, daughter of Rafael Abarca and Francisca Fallas — the subject (own baptism 12 Jun 1873, ark:/61903/1:1:NQ22-Z7Z, same parents). The 1899 register image (ark:/61903/3:1:33S7-9THH-ZP3) was read and calibrated but carries only single surnames and no grandparents, so it corroborates rather than establishes the mother's identity; identity rests on the marriage/baptism index records. The subject G7XQ-GMG is a duplicate of GSJN-6X7 (same parents, name, birth year, husband, one marriage recorded in two systems), to whose child GZ54-NLV the hint is already attached; the correct fix is a duplicate-profile merge, not re-attachment. Resolved by the researcher; independent second genealogist Isaac Boateng concurred.
